questions.text: A hyperbola centered at the origin has foci \((\pm 5,0)\). One asymptote has slope \(\frac{4}{3}\). Find the vertices.

questions.source_label: Chapter 11.4 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q4
questions.text: Consider the hyperbola given by the equation $3x^2 - y^2 - 12x + 10y - 100 = 0$. What is the degree measure of the acute angle between its asymptotes?

Find the least positive angle in degrees coterminal with  
\[
\frac{37\pi}{12}-845^\circ.
\]
